description: This file contains Kotlin unit tests for the `GatewaySession` class, focusing on WebSocket connection handling, token management, and invocation request/response behavior within an Android testing environment using Robolectric. It includes mock server setup, session creation, and various test scenarios related to device tokens, bootstrap tokens, and invocation round-trips.

classes.name: InMemoryDeviceAuthStore
classes.description: In-memory implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore for testing token load, save, and clear operations.

classes.name: NodeHarness
classes.description: Data class holding a GatewaySession, its Job, and a device auth store for test setups.

classes.name: InvokeScenarioResult
classes.description: Holds a request and its corresponding JSON response parameters for invocation tests.

methods.name: connectNodeSession
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for the GatewaySession with specified endpoint, token, and options.

methods.name: awaitConnectedOrThrow
methods.description: Waits for the session to connect within a timeout, throws an error if connection fails.

methods.name: shutdownHarness
methods.description: Cleans up the test harness by disconnecting the session, cancelling jobs, and shutting down server.

methods.name: runInvokeScenario
methods.description: Simulates an invocation request-response cycle within a mock WebSocket server environment.

methods.name: connectResponseFrame
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing a WebSocket response frame for connection acknowledgment.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Sets up a mock WebSocket server with custom dispatch logic to simulate Gateway interactions.
